books.summary: A searing and "magisterial" (Cornel West, New York Times–bestselling author of Democracy Matters) history of American racial exploitation and resistance, told through the turbulent past of the city of St. Louis From Lewis and Clark's 1804 expedition to the 2014 uprising in Ferguson, American history has been made in St. Louis. But friction between Chinese and white settlers on the goldfields of California, Australia, and South Africa catalyzed a global battle over “the Chinese Question”: would the United States and the British Empire outlaw Chinese immigration? awards.name: American Historical Association Publication Prizes
awards.description: The American Historical Association awards publication prizes across historical fields, recognizing books and other historical scholarship.
awards.deadline: Annual prize cycle; see AHA prize pages and current calls for deadlines
awards.criteria: AHA publication prizes are field-specific and are awarded for exceptional books and scholarship in defined historical areas.
awards.prizeAmount: Varies by prize; not yet source-normalized

awards.name: Andrew Carnegie Medal for Excellence in Nonfiction
awards.description: The Andrew Carnegie Medals for Excellence recognize outstanding fiction and nonfiction books for adult readers published in the United States in the previous year.
awards.deadline: Committee-nominated; no open public submission deadline surfaced
awards.criteria: Adult fiction and nonfiction published in the U.S. in the previous year; longlist, finalists, and winners are selected by library professionals.
awards.logoCredit: American Library Association via Wikimedia Commons

awards.name: Bancroft Prize
awards.description: The Bancroft Prizes are awarded annually by Columbia University for distinguished works in American history, including biography, and diplomacy.
awards.criteria: Books must have a copyright date in the previous year and fall under American history, biography, or diplomacy; digital-only books and resubmissions are ineligible.
awards.prizeAmount: $10,000 to each author, according to the 2026 winners announcement

awards.name: Cundill History Prize
awards.description: The Cundill History Prize recognizes history writing in English that combines historical scholarship, originality, literary quality, and broad appeal.
awards.deadline: 2026 submissions closed February 27, 2026; next round expected early 2027
awards.criteria: Open to works of historical nonfiction first published in English during the stated eligibility window; translations are welcomed, while self-published books, textbooks, edited collections, posthumous works, and co-authored works are ineligible.
awards.prizeAmount: US$75,000 winner prize; US$10,000 for each runner-up
awards.logoCredit: Cundill History Prize via Wikimedia Commons

awards.name: Kirkus Prize for Nonfiction
awards.description: The Kirkus Prize honors fiction, nonfiction, and young readers' literature reviewed by Kirkus and selected from starred reviews.
awards.deadline: Automatic eligibility for Kirkus-starred books in the stated publication window; no separate prize-only submission
awards.criteria: Books reviewed by Kirkus Reviews that earn a Kirkus Star and have eligible publication dates are automatically nominated; editors and jurors select finalists and winners.

awards.name: Los Angeles Times Book Prize for History
awards.description: The Los Angeles Times Book Prizes celebrate books from the previous year across multiple categories, including history.
awards.criteria: Eligibility generally requires first U.S. publication in English during the prize year; authors, publishers, agents, and publicists cannot submit titles directly.
awards.prizeAmount: Not prominently sourced on the official FAQ
awards.logoCredit: Los Angeles Times via Wikimedia Commons

awards.name: Mark Lynton History Prize
awards.organization: Columbia Journalism School and the Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard
awards.description: The Mark Lynton History Prize is part of the J. Anthony Lukas Prize Project and recognizes a book-length work of history that combines intellectual distinction with felicity of expression.
awards.criteria: Books must have been published in the United States during the applicable calendar year; anyone, including the author, may submit a book.

awards.name: National Book Award for Nonfiction
awards.description: The National Book Award for Nonfiction is one of the annual National Book Awards recognizing books published by U.S. publishers in the eligibility period.
awards.deadline: May 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. PDT for the 2026 entry form
awards.criteria: Books must be published by a U.S. publisher within the eligibility period; for nonfiction, authors must meet the National Book Foundation's citizenship or long-term U.S. home requirement.

awards.name: National Book Critics Circle Award for Nonfiction
awards.description: The National Book Critics Circle presents annual awards for books published in English across categories including nonfiction.
awards.deadline: No formal submission deadline; publishers may bring books to board attention, with early submission encouraged
awards.criteria: Eligible books are published in English in the United States during the calendar-year awards cycle; NBCC does not charge fees or accept formal official submissions.
awards.prizeAmount: No cash award prominently sourced on the official submissions page
awards.logoCredit: National Book Critics Circle via Wikimedia Commons

awards.name: PEN/John Kenneth Galbraith Award for Nonfiction
awards.description: The PEN/John Kenneth Galbraith Award for Nonfiction honors distinguished general nonfiction with literary merit and critical perspective on contemporary issues.
awards.deadline: Annual PEN America literary-awards cycle; see award page for current submission timing
awards.criteria: Eligible books are single-author nonfiction books published in the United States by a trade or academic publisher in the previous calendar year; biographies and self-published books are ineligible.
awards.logoCredit: PEN American Center via Wikimedia Commons

awards.name: Phi Beta Kappa Book Awards
awards.description: The Phi Beta Kappa Book Awards are given annually to outstanding scholarly books published in the United States and accessible to the general reader.
awards.deadline: 2026 nominations closed November 15, 2025; check official page for the next cycle
awards.criteria: Publisher-submitted books published in the United States, drawn from humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, and mathematics, must be broad in interest and accessible to general readers.

awards.name: PROSE Awards
awards.description: The PROSE Awards recognize professional and scholarly works of merit across subject areas including humanities and social sciences.
awards.deadline: 2026 entries were accepted from September 22 through November 10, 2025 for 2025-copyright works
awards.criteria: Books and nonfiction graphic novels are eligible when submitted by eligible publishers; category winners advance to area awards and the R.R. Hawkins Award.
awards.prizeAmount: No cash prize prominently sourced; entry fee was $115 per entry for the 2026 cycle

awards.name: Pulitzer Prize in History
awards.description: The Pulitzer Prize in History recognizes a distinguished and appropriately documented book on the history of the United States.
awards.deadline: October 15, 2026 at 5:30 p.m. Eastern time for 2026-published books
awards.criteria: Books entries are restricted to eligible works first published in the United States during the relevant calendar year and made available in hardcover or bound paperback for public purchase.
awards.logoCredit: Pulitzer medal image via Wikimedia Commons

awards.name: Wolfson History Prize
awards.description: The Wolfson History Prize recognizes outstanding history writing for a general readership, with past winners listed from 1972 onward.
awards.deadline: Annual submission cycle; see official prize site for current dates
awards.criteria: History books are assessed for excellence in historical research and readability for a wider public audience.
awards.prizeAmount: Current prize amount not yet source-normalized
